name: chkdsk /scan
title: Scan a Windows volume for file-system errors
summary: Runs an online NTFS scan to identify file-system problems without taking the volume offline.

examples.description: Scans the Windows volume online for file-system errors.

permissions.notes: Run from Command Prompt opened as administrator. Use repair options only with separate approval and a verified backup.

risk.warning: The /scan option is diagnostic. Do not substitute /f or /r without understanding downtime, repair, and data-protection requirements.

output_fields.name: Windows has scanned the file system and found no problems
output_fields.description: No logical file-system errors were detected.

output_fields.name: Windows found problems
output_fields.description: The volume needs an approved repair plan and verified backup.

output_fields.name: failed to transfer logged messages
output_fields.description: The scan completed but could not write its report to the event log.

common_errors.message: Access Denied as you do not have sufficient privileges
common_errors.meaning: The terminal was not opened as administrator.

common_errors.message: The type of the file system is not NTFS
common_errors.meaning: The selected online scan option may not apply to that volume.
